From earlier hash tag, from hash (sign) + tag. The hash sign # was initially proposed as tag hash by Chris Messina to create groups on Twitter, modeled after the IRC channel prefix. First published use as hash tag by Stowe Boyd in 2007.

senses.d: A metadata tag, signaled by a preceding hash sign (#), used to label content.
ex: I support the hash tag convention: http://tinyurl.com/2qttlb #hashtag #factoryjoe #twitter
You can also search for a hashtag by typing a topic (without the #) in the search box and clicking Search.

senses.d: The hash sign itself, especially when used as part of a hashtag.
ex: You're perpetually stoned, aren't you? Hashtag four twenty four seven.

senses.d: To label (a message) with a hashtag.
